target_customer: Corporations with hybrid workforces and their employees in Southeast Asia and the Gulf
problem: Hybrid workers wanted a nearby professional workspace without memberships or leases, and companies wanted to avoid long office leases.
business_model: Marketplace taking a cut of per-minute workspace bookings, plus corporate subscriptions

founders.name: Christian Mischler
education: University of St.Gallen (HSG) and CEMS, double master's
founders.background_notes: Former Captain, Swiss Military Intelligence per YC page

founders.name: Raphael Cohen
education: Bachelor of Commerce, University of Toronto

competitors.name: WeWork On Demand
competitors.what: Hourly booking option added in Singapore in 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: Booking app with QR check-in and per-minute billing; the hard part was supply onboarding, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: Supplier network of 100+ spaces by Nov 2021 helps but partners can list on rival apps; the founder says the main rival is F&B chains.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: WeWork added hourly on-demand access in Singapore in 2021; no source shows Deskimo being displaced.

market_need_then: Pandemic hybrid work in 2021 pushed firms to cut leases; TechCrunch reported about 50 properties in Singapore and 40 in Hong Kong at launch priced around 2 to 4 USD per hour.

identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly consumer app tone, tagline Workspaces on demand, paid by the minute

brand_strength.rationale: Regional TechCrunch and e27 coverage focused on founders and funding rather than the brand; no sourced mascot or community.

outcome_analysis: Deskimo, built by repeat founders from the Foodpanda and HotelQuickly orbit, raised a 3 million dollar seed in November 2021 on pandemic hybrid-work demand and expanded from Singapore and Hong Kong to Jakarta and then Malaysia and the UAE. No later round, shutdown or acquisition was found, so it appears to be a small active marketplace whose scale is unknown.
notes: Company website returned 403 to fetch; not worked around. A small pre-seed of about $125K appears only on aggregators and is unverified. One aggregator claims $5.12M total, unverified. Outcome search found no shutdown, acquisition or layoffs. Name origin not found.
